summary.text: Kevin Marsh is the Democratic candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 26B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Lyle Johnstone.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a farmer and educator who taught Idaho history at Idaho State University for more than 20 years.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Marsh earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Oregon in 1989 and a Ph.D. from Washington State University in 2002.
In his survey responses, he said he worked earlier in life as a wildland firefighter and Forest Service ranger.
Marsh said he and his wife, Erika, live near Bellevue in Blaine County, where they run Daisy's Farm and grow produce for local markets.
Marsh named public lands, public schools and rural health care as the focus of his campaign.
He said the Legislature's recent actions threaten those areas and that he would work to defend them.
